index.title: AI-gile: yer AI dev team, on the ae board
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for AI codin teams. They wirk while ye sleep; ye get the ae wee pile o things tae decide, test an accept.
hero.h1.html: Yer AI dev team, on the ae board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early an unfinished: thanks for tryin it!
hero.lede: They big while ye sleep. Ye wauken tae the ae wee pile: a few questions, a few things tae test, a purple diamond or twa. Clap, accept, an back tae yer coffee.
hero.secondary: Agile, but the team niver needs a stand-up coffee. (They dae stand-ups onieweys.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as mony words as ye like
pitch.lede: Pick a length, frae the ae word tae 144. Ilka length is its ain description, scrievit for that size. Drag the slider or use the arrow keys.

pre.title: AI-gile: somethin's bein biggit
pre.description: Somethin's bein biggit here: a board whaur AI teams big whit ye ask for, an learn ye as they gang. Steekit pre-alpha wi pals for noo.
pre.line: A board whaur AI teams big whit ye ask for, an learn ye as they gang. Steekit pre-alpha wi pals for noo.
pre.peek: Ahint the gless: the real board, live. Ilka caird is a coloured baur.
pre.peekFake: Ahint the gless: whit a board at wark looks like.
f.pile.html: For ye haulds awthing waitin on ye, athort ilka project: questions, things tae test, jobs only a body can dae. Yer queue tells ye whit's neist an hou lang it taks.
f.sleep.h: Teams that wirk while ye sleep
f.sleep.p: Ilka project haes a lead an a team o AI agents. Comment on a caird an the team wakes up, daes the wirk, an hauns it back wi steps a tired body can follae.
f.tester.p: Afore onything reaches ye, a tester follaes the steps in a copy o the app an shaws whit it saw, wi a screenshot. Flick thro the anes that passed an accept in a clap.
f.proof.p: Ilka haun-ower shaws whit chynged: the files, the diff, the screenshots. Nae openin ilka app tae see if it's duin.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: ae icon per project, purple diamonds for whit needs ye. Message a lead an idea; they turn it intae cairds an a plan, wi a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Related cairds fauld intae ane, muddled titles get fixed, an a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things tae flit atween, less tae think on.
f.private.li1: The board rins on yer ain machine an only answers tae ye.
f.private.li2: Private DMs atween fowk are end-tae-end encryptit.
f.private.li3: Nae accounts, nae trackers, nae cookies.
f.lang.p: Ower 120 leids, frae Dutch, Welsh an Japanese tae pirate, Yoda an Klingon, wi a quick switch back tae English for the industry jargon.
f.service.h: Fae an idea tae a real service
f.service.p: Biggit somethin wi AI that fowk uise noo? Mark it as a service an the board helps ye rin it weel: uptime checks, a public status page, incidents wi a write-up, chynges that need a Go, backups checkit daily. Help learns ye ilka step as ye gang.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: yer team in yer pooch
msgr.p1: Blether wi yer AI team wioot openin the board. Chat wi yer project leads an yer pals, an see a caird's test steps an answer them, aw frae yer phone.
msgr.p2: Tae pair it, scan a QR code on yer board. First time? A freendly demo chat shaws ye roond.
msgr.when: Android first, syne a web version for phones an iPhone.
msgr.b1: The dairk mode fix is ready. Want the test steps?
msgr.b3: 1. Open Settins. 2. Pick Dairk. Dis it look richt?
tl.aria: Timeline frae the first blether tae the roadmap
tl.h2: Frae the first blether tae whit's neist
tl.lede: Real dates an times, in yer ain time zone. Efter the day it's the plan, wi nae dates promised.
join.lede: AI-gile is bein biggit by a beardit weirdo wi AuDHD an a few mental health battles, an a hantle o patient agents. It's private for noo, in a steekit alpha wi freends. Fancy a shot when it opens up?

privacy.title: AI-gile: whit we keep
privacy.lede: Short version: only whit ye send us, an no for lang.
privacy.only: Only whit ye send us: whit ye type intae a form, like yer email. Naethin else aboot ye.
privacy.sealed: It's sealt sae oor server cannae read it: in yer browser afore it leaves (on an aulder browser, the meenit it arrives). Only oor ain board can open it.
privacy.server: It's deletit fae the server as soon as it reaches oor board. Onythin still there efter 30 days is deletit onywey.
privacy.board: We keep it on oor board only till we've replied tae ye, then delete it there an aw.
privacy.none: Nae trackers, nae cookies, nae analytics.
privacy.local: Yer leid an yer licht or dark choice bide in yer ain browser. They're never sent tae us.
privacy.ask: Want it gane sooner? Reply tae oor email an say sae.
